en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's get our bodies moving
Let's clean up a little
I'm tired...
Why do I need to do that?

My magic makes me healthy 
without needing to exercise.

Also when I move around, it just makes
me tired. You can do it by yourself.
Yeah, the air's stagnant in here...

Stagnant air can have a negative 
effect on magic...

Alright then, get cleaning!
I'll coach you!

<CLT=cltMIND>...So I'm going to do it
myself, then.

Nyeh? But you haven't done 
anything yet.
But if you wanna rest, I don't mind.

We don't need to exercise just 
because we came to the gym...

It seems like you're beginning to 
understand magic more and more.

It'd be possible to make you my 
pupil...if you really wanted.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
(Nyeh...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Himiko's inner thoughts...?
